meta.note: Compiled from public defence-news reporting, Wikipedia, and HAL statements available as of Aug 2026. Program timelines in this sector shift frequently -- treat dates as directional, not contractual, and re-verify before citing to a panel.

items.purpose: Single-engine multirole light combat fighter for IAF frontline squadrons
items.status: In production; 180 aircraft on order, ~15 delivered as of mid-2026, 20+ airframes complete awaiting engine/radar integration
items.mission: Air superiority, ground attack, frontline fighter replacement for MiG-21 fleet
items.description: HAL's flagship indigenous fighter program and largest current production commitment; delivery pace has been constrained by GE engine supply delays, prompting a ~Rs 10,000 crore HAL infrastructure expansion at Bengaluru and Nashik.

items.purpose: 4.5-generation multirole fighter bridging Tejas Mk1A and the future AMCA
items.status: Prototype structural assembly underway; first flight most recently targeted March-July 2027 (slipped from earlier 2026 estimates)
items.mission: Extended-range multirole combat, larger payload (up to 6,500 kg) than Mk1A
items.power_generation: Single turbofan, afterburning, higher thrust class than Mk1A
items.description: Positioned as the capability bridge to AMCA; program has slipped multiple times since its original 2022-23 target, most recently to a mid-2027 first flight per HAL's CMD at Farnborough 2026.

items.purpose: Multi-role utility helicopter for military and civil operators
items.status: Operational, in service; civil 'Dhruv NG' variant expected certification by August 2026
items.mission: Utility transport, SAR, disaster response, VIP/heli-tourism (civil variant)
items.description: HAL's most mature indigenous helicopter family; base airframe for the Rudra and Prachand derivatives. Civil Dhruv NG has orders from Pawan Hans pending certification.

items.purpose: Weaponized armed variant of the Dhruv ALH
items.status: Operational, in service with Indian Army
items.description: Weaponized Dhruv derivative fielded ahead of the purpose-built Prachand LCH.

items.purpose: Dedicated attack helicopter for high-altitude and combat operations
items.status: In production and delivery; 156 units on order across Army and Air Force
items.engine: Shakti (Ardiden 1H1 turboshaft); HTSE-1200 proposed as future indigenous alternative
items.description: India's first indigenously designed and built dedicated attack helicopter, purpose-built for high-altitude operations (relevant to Siachen/Ladakh-type theatres).

items.purpose: Replacement for the ageing Cheetah/Chetak helicopter fleet
items.status: Nearing operational service; ~10 built, undergoing final military trials
items.mission: High-altitude reconnaissance and utility transport, replacing legacy light helicopters
items.description: Intended to replace India's oldest operational helicopter types; deliveries expected to begin as trials complete.

items.purpose: Regional commercial jet airliner, localized for Indian manufacture
items.mission: Regional passenger transport, ~103 seats, ~3,500 km range
items.description: Marks HAL's most significant return to civil airliner manufacturing since the Avro era; developed under Make in India localization of the Russian Superjet design.

items.purpose: Light twin-turboprop for regional connectivity (UDAN scheme)
items.status: In production and delivery; showcased at Wings India 2024 and 2026
items.mission: Short-haul regional airliner, air taxi, medevac, aerial survey, cargo
items.description: HAL's indigenous light transport aircraft supporting India's regional air connectivity (UDAN) program.
